svg.title: SWOT GeoScience RAG pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the two phases of the RAG system: ingestion (PDFs to vector store) and query (user question to LLM answer with citations)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Where do I find SWOT papers to download as PDFs?')
sendPrompt('How does PDF chunking work in LangChain?')
sendPrompt('What embedding model should I use for scientific text?')
sendPrompt('What is FAISS and how does it store vectors?')
sendPrompt('What kinds of questions can this RAG answer?')
sendPrompt('How is the question embedded to match chunks?')
sendPrompt('How does similarity search work in FAISS?')
sendPrompt('How do I build a good RAG prompt with context?')
sendPrompt('What LLM should I use for the RAG answer generation?')
sendPrompt('How do I return citations from retrieved chunks?')
sendPrompt('How should I display the final answer to the user?')
